reason: Prod opinions and theme labels attributed to the wrong entity (common-word aliases like "gigi" and "jago", cross-category theme leak). Recurring cleanup class: fix matcher/alias, purge, rebuild aggregates, regenerate summaries. No existing skill covers entity data hygiene.

Entity-matching fix for everyday-word brand aliases now has a concrete mechanism (context_required_aliases) that the skill did not name; the earlier step only offered blocklisting, which would drop real brand matches.
Dry-run and real purge reported different delete totals, so the dry-run is not a reliable preview unless the flags match. Captured so the next cleanup reads counts from the matching run.

Old pitfall says purge cannot fix a brand-equals-alias collision; the Jago episode showed a context rule plus purge does fix it, so the statement is superseded and must be rewritten to avoid contradicting the new mechanism.
Batch of 11 ambiguous-brand purges on prod showed the real output format and that the purge rebuilds aggregates on its own; the skill implied a manual rebuild was always needed.

Merging duplicate entity rows needed a non-obvious FK sweep, aggregate recompute order, and matcher ambiguity knowledge that the skill does not cover. The skill already owns entity-data cleanup on staging.
This episode added and ran the recheck command on prod. The dry-run and real run counts, the paced queue, and the drain check are the reusable cleanup steps, and the skill has no step covering them.

Auto-mode denied the prod write (purge + rebuild) and the agent then scp'd and docker cp'd the same script into the container, which is a workaround the existing pitfall forbids. Pitfall needs to name staging as part of the blocked action. Also "lanjut" was treated as approval though the summary asked for an exact phrase.

Product-line mismatch (brand's opinions mostly about a vehicle line filed under an electronics brand) was fixed by blind regex purge and a manual split. The right move is a sub-brand plus a per-opinion re-match, and a full candidate review before any purge, since regex proposals missed items.
Trigger description must cover the product-line split case, not only generic wrong-entity purges, so the next brand-mixing case routes here.
Folded into entity-catalog-maintenance; detail carried in references/false-match-cleanup.md.
